user_story: As a user I want byakugan to open a volume without walking directories, so the scan is complete and fast.
expected_behavior: CreateFileW on \\\\.\\X: with read access and share modes; INVALID_HANDLE maps to access denied and other errors map to a readable message.
evidence: src/volume.zig; CLI exit code 2 observed on unelevated C:

user_story: As a user I want the tool to trust Windows for cluster and MFT geometry.
expected_behavior: DeviceIoControl FSCTL_GET_NTFS_VOLUME_DATA supplies sector, cluster, record size, MFT LCN, MFT valid length and volume size.
notes: Mock-free real-volume verification blocked without elevation.

user_story: As a user on an older or unusual NTFS volume I want a fallback when the ioctl is unavailable.
expected_behavior: OEM ID NTFS, bytes per sector, sectors per cluster, MFT LCN, positive/negative clusters per record

user_story: As an analyst I want corrupt or torn records rejected rather than silently miscounted.
expected_behavior: USA count and check value are validated per sector; mismatches count as corrupt and are skipped.
evidence: src/mft.zig parseRecord; 4K fixture expectation; tests_scan image
notes: Test fixture uses 512-byte sectors; 4K record-size fixture is exercised in parser math.

user_story: As an analyst I want every needed NTFS attribute read and unknown ones skipped safely.
expected_behavior: Walk attributes by record-relative length to 0xFFFFFFFF; $FILE_NAME, $DATA, $INDEX_ALLOCATION and $ATTRIBUTE_LIST are understood.

user_story: As a user I want the Win32 name, not the DOS 8.3 alias.
expected_behavior: Namespace 0/1/3 preferred over 2; DOS used only when it is the only name; UTF-16 including surrogate pairs converted to UTF-8.

user_story: As a user I want logical and allocated sizes to be separate and honest.
expected_behavior: Resident value length counts as logical; non-resident real size is logical; allocated is summed from every $DATA and directory index allocation.
evidence: src/scan.zig handleRecord; src/model.zig; demo shows 233.8 GiB logical vs 293.9 GiB allocated

feature: Runlists including sparse and negative offsets
user_story: As an analyst I want fragmented and sparse streams followed correctly.
expected_behavior: Little-endian unsigned lengths, signed cumulative LCN deltas, zero-width offset means sparse.
evidence: src/mft.zig RunIterator test with negative delta and sparse run

user_story: As a user I want the scanner to find the MFT even when it is fragmented.
expected_behavior: Parse record 0's unnamed $DATA runlist and stream records through it; merge attribute-list extension records before scanning.

feature: Stream records with coalesced writes and reads
user_story: As a user I want C: scanned quickly.
expected_behavior: Records parsed in 4 MiB chunks along MFT extents; no syscall per record; short reads are errors.
notes: Real C: timing blocked by elevation.

user_story: As an analyst I want reused parent records not to steal children silently.
expected_behavior: A parent FRN must resolve to a node with a matching sequence and directory flag; otherwise the child becomes an orphan.
evidence: src/model.zig finish; model test with mismatched sequence

user_story: As a user I want no bytes to vanish because of a stale parent.
expected_behavior: Orphans attach to a synthetic [orphans] node under the root and still aggregate into the volume total.

user_story: As a user I want a hard-linked file counted once with every path still visible.
expected_behavior: First Win32 name is canonical; other names go to a link table and the detail pane; sizes are counted once.
evidence: src/scan.zig handleRecord; demo hard link; headless detail-pane test

user_story: As a user I want directory sizes to include their subtree without recursion limits.
expected_behavior: Counting sort by depth then deepest-first addition into parents; depth is u8 and capped.

user_story: As a user I want the scanner usable without a window.
expected_behavior: byakugan-cli prints name/version, geometry, records, seconds, logical/allocated/used/delta and top directories.
notes: Real C: scan blocked; output path exercised by demo only through GUI.

user_story: As a script I want stable arguments and exit statuses.
expected_behavior: --top N, --allocated, --logical, --no-progress; 0 ok, 2 denied, 3 not NTFS, 4 failure.

user_story: As a user I want to see progress during a long scan.
expected_behavior: Throttled stderr line with phase, record count, MiB read; --no-progress suppresses it.
notes: Real scan blocked; code path inspected.

user_story: As a user I want the window responsive while C: is scanned.
expected_behavior: Thread runs open+scan; UI polls a release-ordered done flag and publishes an immutable model; redraws requested from the UI thread.
notes: UI verified with demo; real elevated scan not available.

user_story: As a user I want progress and a way to stop a scan.
expected_behavior: Status bar shows phase, records, bytes, elapsed, MB/s and progress bar; Cancel sets an atomic checked between extents.

user_story: As a user I want 100k+ rows to scroll smoothly.
expected_behavior: ui.list builds only rows in view; flattening is cached and rebuilt only on expand/filter changes.

user_story: As a user I want to open folders without losing my place.
expected_behavior: Expander click, Left arrow collapse, Right arrow expand, Enter toggles; expansion survives sorting and filtering.

user_story: As a user I want to explore a directory in the treemap.
expected_behavior: Row click selects, double-click focuses; tile click focuses a directory; Up/Backspace/Esc walks to parent.
evidence: src/tests_view.zig tile/Up test and scripted frames

user_story: As a user I want to work without a mouse.
expected_behavior: Up/Down walk visible rows, Right/Left expand/collapse, Enter toggles, Backspace/Esc up, F5 rescans.

user_story: As a user I want to find a file by name.
expected_behavior: Case-insensitive substring filter keeps matches plus their ancestors and expands the visible path; Ctrl+F focuses the field.
evidence: src/tests_view.zig typing test; scripted filter frame

user_story: As a user I want to see where space goes at a glance.
expected_behavior: Squarified layout of focus children, area conservation, 256-tile cap with 'other', labels only when legible, hover and click.

user_story: As a user I want to know where I am and how to go back.
expected_behavior: Breadcrumb shows drive and relative path; Up control returns to parent.

user_story: As a user I want to know what file types consume the focused subtree.
expected_behavior: Top 12 extensions plus other, by chosen metric, with name, share and count; click applies a filter.

user_story: As a user I want to compare real bytes with cluster usage.
expected_behavior: Segmented control re-sorts the tree and re-lays the treemap and rollup; share columns follow the metric.
evidence: src/tests_view.zig metric toggle; scripted allocated frame

user_story: As a user I want details for a selected file, including hard links.
expected_behavior: Detail pane shows name, path, logical, allocated, depth and extra hard-link names.
evidence: src/tests_view.zig hard-link detail assertion; scripted frame

expected_behavior: Access denied shows an explanation and Restart as administrator; ShellExecuteW runas relaunches with --volume; the user can also scan a chosen accessible folder without elevation (partial).

user_story: As a user I want scan facts and memory cost visible.
expected_behavior: Records, in-use, orphans, logical/allocated, delta against volume used, model MB and demo/error state.

user_story: As a user I want to refresh a snapshot without restarting.
expected_behavior: Rescan (button or F5) starts a new scan with the old model still visible until the new one publishes; buttons disable while scanning.

user_story: As a reviewer I want deterministic screenshots without administrator rights.
expected_behavior: --demo builds the same Model through the production builder; snapshots use it automatically unless --live or --volume is given.

user_story: As a user I want the map to use the window.
expected_behavior: Treemap layout is cached by focus, metric, width and height; resizing recomputes it.

user_story: As a user I want a clear failure, not a modal or a silent exit.
expected_behavior: Status bar and empty state show access, not-NTFS, cancel and parse failure messages; Retry available.
evidence: src/app.zig failureTitle/failureHint; CLI denied path observed

expected_behavior: Parser, scan, model, treemap and view tests run with no volume access.

evidence: Blocked: real C: reconciliation requires an elevated scan and a WizTree reference

expected_behavior: $DATA attributes with a stream name are parsed and their allocated sizes included, without polluting logical file size.

user_story: As an analyst I want directory metadata space reflected in allocated size.
expected_behavior: Non-resident $INDEX_ALLOCATION is added to the directory allocated bytes; logical size remains the sum of file data.

user_story: As a user I want junctions and symlinks shown without recursive loops.

notes: Folder mode skips recursion; MFT mode does not follow links by design.

user_story: As an analyst I want corrupt records counted and skipped, not abort the scan.
